notes.title: Iwakura Aria is in Next Fest!
notes.content: [h3][b]Next Fest is here, and Iwakura Aria is part of it![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Try Iwakura Aria for the first time. The Trial version features three areas of the story that you can explore: [/p][p]🏰 [b]The Iwakura Mansion[/b][/p][p][b]🫀 Her Body[/b][/p][p][b]👭 Aria and Ichiko[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Play through each part and get a feel for the atmosphere, characters, and the deeper story that awaits.[/p][p]Iwakura Aria is a moving visual novel that follows the deepening connection between Ichiko and Aria. As you progress, tension builds and unsettling truths begin to surface. Not everything is as it seems and what looks harmless might not be.[/p][p]You’ll play as Ichiko, experiencing life within the Iwakura Mansion. But Aria isn’t just along for the ride she begins to grow with you. The story weaves your connection tighter, revealing more about her and the others who live in the mansion.[/p][p]Play each part of the Iwakura Aria Trial version now and uncover different layers of the narrative!🕯️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341850/6d93da7b9c7b1353bb54a13965846eca3f60dd7f.jpg"][/img][/p]
